name: @vipentti/planlet
description: Repository-local planning and task management for AI coding agents: focused Markdown planlets plus a deterministic CLI and portable agent skills. Small plans. Clear handoffs.
author: Ville Penttinen

scripts.skills:update: npm run build && node dist/planlet.mjs update --tools all
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASING.md "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASING.md "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
